text:
full clip with Jeter and Bush in the locker room....so good

Jeter: "I hear you're throwing out the first pitch, Mr. President. Will you be doing it from the mound, or the front of the mound?"

Bush: "I think I'll throw from the front of the mound."

Jeter: "I wouldn't do that if I were you, Mr. President. You're gonna get booed. This is Yankee Stadium."

Bush: "Okay. I'll throw from the mound."

Jeter starts walking out, turns, looks over his shoulder and says:

"Don't bounce it. They'll boo ya."
